name: text-3d-flip
title: Text 3D Flip
description: Letters that flip in 3D, one after another, when hovered.
usage:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Text3DFlip } from '@/components/ui/text-3d-flip'
</script>

<template>
  <Text3DFlip
    class="text-5xl"
    text-class="bg-background text-foreground"
    flip-text-class="bg-background text-foreground"
    rotate-direction="top"
  >
    Stay hungry, stay foolish
  </Text3DFlip>
</template>

props.name: text
props.description: The text to flip. Falls back to the text of the default slot.

props.name: textClass
props.description: Classes for each letter's front face (visible before the flip).

props.name: flipTextClass
props.description: Classes for each letter's back face (revealed by the flip).

props.name: staggerDuration
props.description: Seconds between each letter starting its flip.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Plain text to flip, used when the `text` prop is not set.
